verdict.rationale: Stacked change workflows are a fair question for a Git hosting and merge-request platform like GitLab, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack mentions merge requests only generically (security findings, agents, review instructions). Nothing documents splitting a change into stacked or dependent merge requests, per-member readiness, or ordered stack merging. The official CLI probe (gitlab-probe-3) does not describe any stacking feature either.
